# awscc_sagemaker_artifact (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SageMaker::Artifact



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the artifact.
- `artifact_name` (String) The name of the artifact. Must be unique to your account in an AWS Region.
- `artifact_type` (String) The artifact type.
- `creation_time` (String) When the artifact was created.
- `last_modified_time` (String) When the artifact was last modified.
- `metadata_properties` (Attributes) Metadata properties of the tracking entity, trial, or trial component. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata_properties))
- `properties` (Map of String) A list of properties to add to the artifact.
- `source` (Attributes) The source of the artifact. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tags to apply to the artifact. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata_properties`

Read-Only:

- `commit_id` (String) The commit ID.
- `generated_by` (String) The entity this entity was generated by.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID.
- `repository` (String) The repository.


<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Read-Only:

- `source_types` (Attributes List) A list of source types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--source_types))
- `source_uri` (String) The URI of the source.

### Nested Schema for `source.source_types`

Read-Only:

- `source_id_type` (String) The type of ID.
